pages.text: The Omnipotence Core is not the end. Its $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$() destroys the Transcendental - and that is the way forward, not a loss.$(br2)What happens next, in order:

$(li)$(bold)The Sundering$(): the Core leaves $(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() and the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(). The old machines turn shards into $(item)Omnipotence Dust$(), $(item)Apeiron Ingots$(), $(item)Pleroma Crystal$() and $(item)Logos Thread$().$(li)$(bold)The Rekindling$(): those build the $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$(), the largest machine there is. Fed the Echo, it rebuilds the Transcendental.$(li)$(bold)The Forge$(): the reborn Core can $(thing)forge$() - by solving a simulated universe's constants of nature - what even Omnipotence could not simply make.

The last things, all forged at the reborn Core:$(li)$(item)Omnipotent Ingot$(), $(item)Crystal of Transcendence$(), $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), $(item)Eschaton Core$()$(li)the $(item)Omnipotent Edge$(), the $(item)Scepter of Singularities$(), the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$() and the $(item)Dodecaract Excavator$()$(li)the $(item)Ex Nihilo Engine$() (endless power), the $(item)Lawgiver's Codex$(), the $(item)Censer of Entropy$() and the $(item)Equilibrium Lattice$()$(li)$(item)Eschaton Cells$() - every endgame item runs on their charge$(li)and at the very end, an $(item)Omnipotence Core$() of your own, with the $(item)Hand of the Demiurge$() to tune, wake and move it.
Each of these has its own chapter, which opens as you get there: The Sundering opens the shards' chapters, The Rekindling the Forge's.
